root_cause.text: The USB subsystem unanchors URBs before invoking their completion callback, so URBs resubmitted in esd_usb_read_bulk_callback() were not re-anchored to dev->rx_submitted, causing them to be missed during cleanup in esd_usb_close() and resulting in a memory leak.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message states: "the USB framework unanchors the URB before the complete function is called... once an in-URB has been completed, it is no longer anchored and is ultimately not released in esd_usb_close()." The patch adds `usb_anchor_urb(urb, &dev->rx_submitted)` before resubmitting and `usb_unanchor_urb(urb)` on error.
